_comments: WEEKLY LAPSED CLOSE DATE DIGEST. Fires the agent in `agents/.sales-agents.json`. Own file, as
SEEDED Disabled. A host has to fill in three Application Settings first (DigestProvider,
DigestFromAddress and, for links, ExplorerBaseUrl) and add its own Deal Digest Recipients rows;
enabled before that, every run stops on the missing provider. Enable it once those are in place,
after a run with {"dryRun": true} as StartingPayload has shown what would be sent.
TWO TIME ZONES, DELIBERATELY. The cron Timezone below governs WHEN the email is delivered (Monday
09:00 here). BizApps.BusinessTimeZone governs which calendar day a deal's close date is judged
against. They are separate settings with separate jobs, not one inconsistency: a host delivering
in one zone can judge deals in another.
The scheduler does not pick up job rows written out of process. After a metadata push, restart
MJAPI or this job will not be scheduled, whatever its Status says.
· ConcurrencyMode `Skip` — two overlapping runs would send each recipient two emails.
· MissedRunPolicy `RunOnce` — a missed week is not worth several catch-up emails; one covers it.
· RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun `false` — the first run waits for the schedule.
JobTypeID resolves by name rather than a raw UUID: self-documenting, and it cannot break on a
host whose Agent job type has a different ID.

fields.Name: Sales — Lapsed Close Date Digest (weekly)
fields.Description: Emails each digest recipient the deals whose expected close date has lapsed. Ships Disabled until a host has set the digest Application Settings and added recipients.
